files.content:
name: Build KaryoOS Android APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: 8.9

      - name: Build Debug & Release APKs
        run: gradle assembleDebug assembleRelease --no-daemon

      - name: Upload APK Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: KaryoOSAgent-APKs
          path: |
            app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
            app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

      - name: Publish GitHub Release with APK
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}
          name: KaryoOS Agent v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}
          files: |
            app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
            app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO" />
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="32" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES"
        tools:ignore="QueryAllPackagesPermission" />

    <queries>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />
            <data android:scheme="https" />
        </intent>
    </queries>

    <application
        android:name=".VirtualOsApplication"
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:fullBackupContent="false"
        android:icon="@android:drawable/sym_def_app_icon"
        android:label="@string/app_name"
        android:largeHeap="false"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.KaryoOSAgent"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="false">

        <activity
            android:name=".MainActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- Android Accessibility Service Limb for UI inspection & safe gesture/text dispatch -->
        <service
            android:name=".limbs.accessibility.AgentAccessibilityService"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/accessibility_service_label"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.accessibilityservice"
                android:resource="@xml/accessibility_service_config" />
        </service>

        <!-- Foreground service keeping active multi-step tasks alive under 4GB RAM limits -->
        <service
            android:name=".scheduler.AgentForegroundService"
            android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync" />

        <!-- WorkManager Foreground Service declaration for Android 14+ -->
        <service
            android:name="androidx.work.impl.foreground.SystemForegroundService"
            android:foregroundServiceType="dataSync"
            tools:node="merge" />

        <receiver
            android:name=".scheduler.BootCompletedReceiver"
            android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
    </application>
</manifest>

package com.virtualos.agent.scheduler

import android.app.Service
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.IBinder
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import com.virtualos.agent.VirtualOsApplication

/**
 * Lightweight foreground service preventing premature process kill on 4 GB RAM devices
 * while the user runs multi-step browser or Accessibility automation tasks.
 */
class AgentForegroundService : Service() {

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, VirtualOsApplication.AGENT_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle("KaryoOS Agent Active")
            .setContentText("Autonomous workspace session running")
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_media_play)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .build()

        startForeground(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    companion object {
        private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 4101
    }
}

package com.virtualos.agent.scheduler

import android.content.Context
import androidx.work.BackoffPolicy
import androidx.work.Constraints
import androidx.work.ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy
import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy
import androidx.work.NetworkType
import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder
import androidx.work.PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder
import androidx.work.WorkManager
import androidx.work.workDataOf
import com.virtualos.agent.data.queue.ScheduledTaskEntity
import com.virtualos.agent.data.queue.TaskQueueDatabase
import com.virtualos.agent.domain.model.ScheduledTask
import com.virtualos.agent.domain.model.TaskQueueStatus
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class AgentTaskScheduler(
    context: Context,
    private val database: TaskQueueDatabase
) {
    private val workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(context)

    fun observeTasks(): Flow<List<ScheduledTask>> = database.observeDomainTasks()

    suspend fun enqueueTask(
        title: String,
        prompt: String,
        isRecurring: Boolean,
        intervalHours: Long = 12L,
        requiresUnmeteredNetwork: Boolean = false,
        requiresBatteryNotLow: Boolean = true
    ): ScheduledTask {
        val taskId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val task = ScheduledTask(
            id = taskId,
            title = title.trim(),
            prompt = prompt.trim(),
            isRecurring = isRecurring,
            intervalHours = intervalHours.coerceAtLeast(1L),
            requiresUnmeteredNetwork = requiresUnmeteredNetwork,
            requiresBatteryNotLow = requiresBatteryNotLow,
            status = TaskQueueStatus.QUEUED,
            createdAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
        )
        database.scheduledTaskDao().upsert(ScheduledTaskEntity.fromDomain(task))

        val constraints = Constraints.Builder()
            .setRequiredNetworkType(if (requiresUnmeteredNetwork) NetworkType.UNMETERED else NetworkType.CONNECTED)
            .setRequiresBatteryNotLow(requiresBatteryNotLow)
            .build()

        val input = workDataOf(
            AgentWorker.KEY_TASK_ID to task.id,
            AgentWorker.KEY_TASK_TITLE to task.title,
            AgentWorker.KEY_TASK_PROMPT to task.prompt
        )

        if (isRecurring) {
            val periodicRequest = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<AgentWorker>(
                intervalHours.coerceAtLeast(1L),
                TimeUnit.HOURS
            )
                .setConstraints(constraints)
                .setInputData(input)
                .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 15, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
                .build()

            workManager.enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
                uniqueWorkName(task.id),
                ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE,
                periodicRequest
            )
        } else {
            val oneTimeRequest = OneTimeWorkRequestBuilder<AgentWorker>()
                .setConstraints(constraints)
                .setInputData(input)
                .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
                .build()

            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(
                uniqueWorkName(task.id),
                ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE,
                oneTimeRequest
            )
        }

        return task
    }

    suspend fun cancelTask(taskId: String) {
        workManager.cancelUniqueWork(uniqueWorkName(taskId))
        database.scheduledTaskDao().deleteById(taskId)
    }

    private fun uniqueWorkName(taskId: String): String = "karyo_task_$taskId"
}

package com.virtualos.agent

import android.app.Application
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.os.Build
import com.virtualos.agent.agent.AgentOrchestrator
import com.virtualos.agent.agent.GuardrailEngine
import com.virtualos.agent.agent.LowMemoryMonitor
import com.virtualos.agent.brain.BrainRouter
import com.virtualos.agent.brain.GeminiClient
import com.virtualos.agent.brain.OpenRouterClient
import com.virtualos.agent.data.queue.TaskQueueDatabase
import com.virtualos.agent.data.security.EncryptedVaultStore
import com.virtualos.agent.data.workspace.SandboxedWorkspaceManager
import com.virtualos.agent.limbs.media.VideoEditorLimb
import com.virtualos.agent.limbs.os.ClipboardAndIntentLimb
import com.virtualos.agent.limbs.store.PlayStoreLimb
import com.virtualos.agent.limbs.voice.VoiceCommandController
import com.virtualos.agent.limbs.webview.WebViewAutomationController
import com.virtualos.agent.scheduler.AgentTaskScheduler
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class VirtualOsApplication : Application() {

    lateinit var vaultStore: EncryptedVaultStore
        private set
    lateinit var workspaceManager: SandboxedWorkspaceManager
        private set
    lateinit var taskDatabase: TaskQueueDatabase
        private set
    lateinit var webViewController: WebViewAutomationController
        private set
    lateinit var voiceController: VoiceCommandController
        private set
    lateinit var videoEditorLimb: VideoEditorLimb
        private set
    lateinit var clipboardLimb: ClipboardAndIntentLimb
        private set
    lateinit var playStoreLimb: PlayStoreLimb
        private set
    lateinit var guardrailEngine: GuardrailEngine
        private set
    lateinit var lowMemoryMonitor: LowMemoryMonitor
        private set
    lateinit var brainRouter: BrainRouter
        private set
    lateinit var orchestrator: AgentOrchestrator
        private set
    lateinit var taskScheduler: AgentTaskScheduler
        private set

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        createNotificationChannel()

        val httpClient = OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .connectTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(45, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .writeTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .build()

        vaultStore = EncryptedVaultStore(this)
        workspaceManager = SandboxedWorkspaceManager(this)
        taskDatabase = TaskQueueDatabase.getInstance(this)
        webViewController = WebViewAutomationController()
        voiceController = VoiceCommandController(this)
        videoEditorLimb = VideoEditorLimb(this)
        clipboardLimb = ClipboardAndIntentLimb(this)
        playStoreLimb = PlayStoreLimb(this, vaultStore)
        guardrailEngine = GuardrailEngine()
        lowMemoryMonitor = LowMemoryMonitor(this, vaultStore, webViewController)
        registerComponentCallbacks(lowMemoryMonitor)

        val geminiClient = GeminiClient(httpClient)
        val openRouterClient = OpenRouterClient(httpClient)
        brainRouter = BrainRouter(vaultStore, geminiClient, openRouterClient)

        orchestrator = AgentOrchestrator(
            appContext = this,
            brainRouter = brainRouter,
            vaultStore = vaultStore,
            workspaceManager = workspaceManager,
            webViewController = webViewController,
            videoEditorLimb = videoEditorLimb,
            clipboardLimb = clipboardLimb,
            playStoreLimb = playStoreLimb,
            guardrailEngine = guardrailEngine,
            lowMemoryMonitor = lowMemoryMonitor
        )
        taskScheduler = AgentTaskScheduler(this, taskDatabase)
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                AGENT_CHANNEL_ID,
                getString(R.string.notification_channel_agent),
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            ).apply {
                description = getString(R.string.notification_channel_agent_desc)
            }
            val manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
            manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val AGENT_CHANNEL_ID = "karyo_agent_channel"
    }
}

files.content:
# KaryoOS — Autonomous Android Virtual Workspace & OS Agent

Complete, production-ready Kotlin + Jetpack Compose Android application implementing a local sandboxed Virtual Workspace ("হাত-পা" / Limbs) paired with a Multi-Key / Multi-Provider Gemini + OpenRouter AI Brain Router ("মস্তিষ্ক" / Brain).

## Architecture Overview

- `domain/model/`: Strongly typed `AgentStepPlan`, `BrainRouterConfig`, `UserProfileVault`, `ScheduledTask`, and `MemoryProfile` models.
- `data/security/EncryptedVaultStore.kt`: Android Keystore AES-256-GCM `EncryptedSharedPreferences` for storing multiple Gemini & OpenRouter API keys, routing rules, and personal profile data.
- `data/workspace/SandboxedWorkspaceManager.kt`: Canonical-path-confined virtual filesystem inside `filesDir/agent_workspace/` (`research/`, `drafts/`, `scripts/`, `history/`).
- `data/queue/TaskQueueDatabase.kt`: Room database persisting scheduled and recurring tasks.
- `brain/BrainRouter.kt`: Thread-safe multi-key rotation and automatic fallback across Gemini (`gemini-2.5-flash` / `gemini-2.5-pro`) and OpenRouter (`google/gemini-2.5-flash` / `anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`). Automatically rotates on HTTP 429 rate limits, quota exhaustion, auth rejection, or transient network errors.
- `limbs/webview/WebViewAutomationController.kt`: Controlled WebView automation with JS DOM snapshot extraction, CSS selector filling/clicking, and memory trimming.
- `limbs/accessibility/AgentAccessibilityService.kt` + `AccessibilityBridge.kt`: OS-level `AccessibilityService` capable of reading active window UI nodes, performing clicks/gestures, typing text, scrolling, and launching apps safely.
- `agent/AgentOrchestrator.kt` + `GuardrailEngine.kt` + `LowMemoryMonitor.kt`: Structured `Observe -> Plan -> Act -> Verify` loop supporting Bengali (`বাংলা`) and English commands, 4 GB RAM optimization mode (`maxConcurrentTasks = 1`, trimmed DOM & log caps), and mandatory Human-in-the-Loop confirmation before sensitive actions (`SUBMIT_SENSITIVE_FORM`, `ACCOUNT_LOGIN_OR_SIGNUP`, `PAYMENT_ACTION`, `WORKSPACE_DELETE_FILE`).
- `scheduler/AgentWorker.kt` + `AgentTaskScheduler.kt`: WorkManager `CoroutineWorker` with network/battery constraints and Android 14+ `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC` support.

## Opening & Building in Android Studio

1. Open `/android-app` in Android Studio Ladybug (or newer) with JDK 17.
2. Sync Gradle and run on an Android 8.0+ (API 26+) device or emulator.
3. Open the **Brain** tab inside the app to add one or more Gemini / OpenRouter API keys and optionally enable **KaryoOS Virtual Limbs Service** in Android Accessibility Settings.
4. Open the **Vault** tab to store your profile details for automated form filling and to schedule recurring WorkManager routines.
